description: This file defines the ValidationUniqueDao class, which provides data access methods for checking the uniqueness of certain values within entities in the OrangeHRM system's core DAO layer. Specifically, it contains the method isValueUnique to verify if a value is unique according to specified criteria.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueDao
classes.description: A data access object class responsible for validation of unique values in entities within the OrangeHRM core system.

methods.name: isValueUnique
methods.description: Checks if a given value is unique for a specified entity and attribute, optionally considering entity ID and match conditions, by constructing a query and verifying the count.
